name: GuideBeam
description:
GuideBeam brings a person's validated career profile into Claude so advice can start from evidence rather than a blank chat. With the user's OAuth permission, Claude can read factor-level personality results, RIASEC interests, relative work-value priorities, stated career direction, career matches, hobbies, weekly check-ins, and the next useful GuideBeam step.

Users can ask Claude to compare career options, explore strengths and tensions, plan a transition, or turn a weekly reflection into a practical next action. When explicitly requested, Claude can also add or remove a hobby, record a check-in, or send structured career facts to GuideBeam as pending suggestions for the user to review.

Assessments are completed in GuideBeam, not in chat. Profile reads are free. Ongoing connector writes require GuideBeam Pro, with one free initial structured-context sync for new users. The connector never requests Claude memory, chat history, conversation transcripts or summaries, or attached files. Access is restricted to the signed-in user's GuideBeam account and can be disconnected or revoked.

_published_faq.name: How do I add GuideBeam to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add GuideBeam to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://www.guidebeam.com/api/mcp/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the GuideBeam MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: GuideBeam lists 13 MCP tools, including add_hobby, get_career_direction, get_career_matches, get_interests, get_latest_checkin, get_next_step, get_personality, get_profile_summary, get_values, list_hobbies, record_checkin, and remove_hobby.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to GuideBeam?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to GuideBeam in education on the Manufact MCP catalog include DocCheck Flexikon, Vocaneo, Grammaropolis, TheWholeTorah, and Fryd - Your Gardening Companion.
GuideBeam requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
GuideBeam is developed by GuideBeam Pty Ltd. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
